description: This file defines custom exception classes related to task operations within the Superset project, including errors for task not found, invalid parameters, creation/update failures, abort failures, permission issues, and disabled framework scenarios.

classes.name: TaskNotFoundError
classes.description: Exception raised when a specified task cannot be found.

classes.name: TaskAbortFailedError
classes.description: Exception when aborting a task fails.

classes.name: TaskNotAbortableError
classes.description: Exception when attempting to abort a non-abortable task.

classes.name: TaskPermissionDeniedError
classes.description: Exception when user lacks permission for task operations.

classes.name: GlobalTaskFrameworkDisabledError
classes.description: Exception when the global task framework is disabled but a task is called or scheduled.

methods.name: TaskPermissionDeniedError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the exception with an optional custom message.
